comparison: P12 native Q4_K_M versus its own Transformers FP16 checkpoint
caveat: Runtime and precision both change. These labels explain observed failed stages, not all possible semantic defects.

cases.evidence: Q4 inserts Add, then unrelated Remove/Clear methods, and ends at an unfinished Size declaration. Go reports unexpected }, expected (.

Q4 emits </file> and a new <target> header into the Python insertion; compilation rejects </file>. FP16's empty completion passes this fixture, so that pass is not evidence of a useful nonempty suggestion.
Q4 completes gcd, adds lcm and main, then reaches the ceiling in assert lcm(12, 1. The compiler reports an unclosed parenthesis.
Q4 completes gcd and adds a test plus an unfinished #[test attribute. Rust reports mismatched and unexpected closing delimiters against the unchanged suffix.
Q4 completes classifyNumber then adds classifyString, ending inside else if (. TypeScript reports TS1109 and TS1128.

The FP16 control adds a duplicate LRUCache declaration after closing the class. Node rejects Identifier 'LRUCache' has already been declared. Q4 passes the unchanged tests; its extra code is not removed.
FP16 completes factorial then adds factorialOfN variants, ending inside return factorial(n. Node reports a missing closing parenthesis. Q4 passes the existing tests.

FP16 completes the frequency dictionary then adds unrelated functions, ending in an unterminated triple-quoted docstring. Python compilation fails. Q4's complete extra docstring parses with the original suffix and passes.

FP16 reaches the ceiling at if result > 1000 before completing safe_div. Rust reports an if expression missing its block. Q4 returns Ok(result), includes extra test code, and passes the existing checks.
